 Working at Hartevelt 
At Hartevelt, you're not just working in logistics - you're part of a family business with a remarkable story. Since 1945, we've been passionately dedicated to the fashion industry, starting out as a small dry cleaner in Zeist and growing into an innovative fulfillment company for leading fashion brands. 
What makes us unique? We combine decades of experience with a forward-looking vision. As a family business, we stand for commitment, short lines of communication, and a close-knit team where everyone matters. With colleagues from different countries, we're a multicultural workplace where English is often the main language. 
At Hartevelt, you'll have the opportunity to develop yourself and grow. We're constantly working on improvement and innovation - from automated sorters to smart packing stations. Whether you're on the floor, in the warehouse, at the office, or in a leadership role, together we ensure our clients can always count on top-quality service.

• Act as the go-to product expert: know everything about our products and actively share this knowledge within cross-functional teams, both locally and at corporate level. 
• Stay up to date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and customer feedback to shape product improvements and future actions 
Your team:

European/corporate level

with go-to-market and POS strategies.
